messages.subject: methseg function
parts:
Dear Altuna / methylkit team,


I have methylation data in a granges object and I am running the methseg function. This works perfectly when my granges object contains all the methylation data (percent methylation at each CpG for each sample). However, it does not work if there is missing data in the granges object (i.e. "NA" - percentage methylation is unknown in certain samples for certain CpGs- this arises because insufficient coverage in some limited CpGs). Is there a way to overcome this please?


Thank you


Sabrina Rossi

PhD student, University of Cambridge

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] methseg function
parts:
Hi Sabrina,
There are a couple of ways the easiest is to drop the CpGs that have NA values and run segmentation without them.

The other way is to impute them. Which is not implemented in methylKit but there are many ways of doing this. We described some of them here: http://compgenomr.github.io/book/data-preprocessing.html#dealing-with-missing-values

Best,
Altuna
